commands.name: lint
commands.description: Run ESLint and Prettier on frontend code
commands.content:
Run ESLint with autofix and Prettier formatting:
```bash
npm run lint -- --fix
npm run format
```

commands.name: test
commands.description: Run frontend tests with Jest and React Testing Library
commands.content:
```bash
npm test
# Run with coverage
npm test -- --coverage
# Run specific test
npm test ComponentName
```

commands.name: build
commands.content:
```bash
npm run build
# Analyze bundle
npm run build -- --analyze
```
